source: Indian-Bank-Statements (AgamiAI), https://huggingface.co/datasets/AgamiAI/Indian-Bank-Statements . IMPORTANT: this dataset is SYNTHETIC (machine-generated statements with invented banks, people and amounts), not real bank statements. Real bank statements are not openly licensable because they carry personal financial data. JevAPI still ran live Jev checks and demos on synthetic text only.
changes: 3 of the documents (one Type-1, two Type-2 layouts). OCR text only; the repeated page watermark ("SYNTHETIC DATA - MACHINE GENERATED") removed; person names replaced with [name removed]; only the first transaction rows kept. The Type-1 layout wraps every row over several lines and prints debit/credit as columns, so the text alone cannot say which rows are debits: the reader proposes only the rows whose amounts sit on the date line (rows 1 and 3 of agamai-type1-00001; transaction numbering counts parsed rows only), and wrapped descriptions stay for a human to check.
